summary: This is a Windows Terminal configuration file that defines a single terminal profile for Docker. The profile is set up to run a Docker Compose shell inside an Ubuntu WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) instance, with custom styling like a background image and a blue tab color.

explanations.5: This command launches a shell inside a Docker container running under WSL's Ubuntu distribution; when you open this profile, it automatically connects you to the docusaurus service defined in a docker-compose file.
explanations.6: This points to an image file on the Windows filesystem that will be displayed as the background of the terminal window.
explanations.7: This number between 0 and 1 controls how transparent the background image is; 0.3 means it's 30% opaque (70% transparent), so you can still see text clearly over it.
explanations.9: This is a unique identifier for this profile; Windows Terminal uses it internally to track and remember settings for this specific configuration.
explanations.12: This sets the folder that opens by default when you launch this profile; the path points to a blog repository inside the Ubuntu WSL filesystem.
